input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves Candidate, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for contact application, contact, i contact. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with home functionality, so that I can accomplish my home-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with location functionality, so that I can accomplish my location-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with sms functionality, so that I can accomplish my sms-related tasks.
